name: @permitzip/bim-pack-electrical
description: MutinyBIM Electrical add-on (namespace electrical, first-party): panels, circuits, feeders and their loads, load-flow on the network core, the one-line diagram graph, panel schedule forms, electrical symbols, dedicated equipment space, NEC calcs and checks, and the agent tools it declares.
